astrum.command.help.header: Astrum debug commands (permission level 2). Slots are numbered 1-5 on the command line; the party and the wheel number them 0-4 internally.
astrum.command.help.roster: /astrum roster - owned characters with level, exp and affection
astrum.command.help.party: /astrum party set <slot 1-5> <characterId> | party clear <slot 1-5> | party list
astrum.command.help.cast: /astrum cast <slot 1-5> - fires that slot, with exactly the validation the cast key uses
astrum.command.help.affection: /astrum affection add <n> [characterId] - clamped at the tier-3 threshold (default: the selected slot)
astrum.command.help.tune: /astrum tune areaCharge [pairCooldownTicks <n> | receiveCapPerSecond <v>] | tune reset - operator tuning for the area_charge guards

effect.astrum.attack_buff.description: Raises your own attack; 5 tiers, 20% each.
effect.astrum.attack_area.description: Raises nearby allies' physical attack; 5 tiers, 20% each.
effect.astrum.magic_attack_area.descript: Raises nearby allies' magic attack; 5 tiers, 26% each.
effect.astrum.phys_defence.description: Reduces physical damage you take; 5 tiers, 12% each.
effect.astrum.magic_defence.description: Reduces magic damage you take; 5 tiers, 12% each.
effect.astrum.defence_down.description: Lowers the target's armour; 4 tiers, 20% each.
effect.astrum.magic_defence_down.descrip: Lowers the target's magic damage reduction; 4 tiers, 20% each.
effect.astrum.shield.description: Absorbs damage; 5 tiers, 20% of max health each. A second grant replaces the first instead of stacking.
effect.astrum.panic.description: The target cannot act for the duration the skill declares (1.5 seconds when it declares none).
effect.astrum.charge_rate.description: More charge from everything; 5 tiers, 25% each.
effect.astrum.charge_regen.description: Restores charge every second; 5 tiers (4/8/12/16/20 per second). The strongest wins when two are active.
effect.astrum.spirit.description: Summons orbiting spirits; 5 tiers, one each.
effect.astrum.taunt.description: Nearby hostile mobs take you as their target and keep their eyes on you; 1 rung, the duration is the cast's.
effect.astrum.phys_immunity.description: Takes no physical damage; magic still lands. 1 rung — immunity, not a percentage.
effect.astrum.control_immunity.descripti: Panic cannot land, and an active panic stops refusing actions. 1 rung; it does not stop damage.
effect.astrum.crit_damage_up.description: Raises crit damage by the stated percent of the multiplier while it runs; party-wide, timed, and it expires by itself.
effect.astrum.crit_chance_up.description: Raises crit chance by the stated percentage points while it runs; party-wide, timed, and it adds to each character’s own chance.
effect.astrum.crit_chance_down.descripti: Lowers the victim's crit chance by the stated percentage points while it runs, as a negative modifier written on the victim; vanilla removes it when the effect ends. Best-source rule: a higher foreign crit-chance source on the target masks it.
effect.astrum.crit_damage_down.descripti: Lowers the victim's crit damage by the stated percent of the multiplier while it runs (a negative multiplier modifier); vanilla removes it when the effect ends.
effect.astrum.charge_counter.description: Restores charge every second, plus a little for each mark the holder carries; the marks are read live, so spending them slows the refill.
effect.astrum.wind_blade.description: A state: the holder has 风之刃. 怜's counter slash branch only fires while it is held.
effect.astrum.tea_pot.description: A state: the holder has 西式小茶壶. 铃莓's tea-pot branches only fire while it is held.
effect.astrum.marker_125.description: A state: the holder has 标记 ID 125. 矛依未's second loop only fires its extra SP1+ / SP2 segments while it is held.
